mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment (post_id, user_id, parent_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, user_id, parent_id, content, created_at FROM post_comment WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM post_comment c INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND parent_id IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_comment WHERE id = #{id} OR parent_id = #{id}
